_howTo: Home page 'Now on the Shelf'. Add, remove or reorder items. tag is a short label like "New Arrival", "Staff Pick" or "Michigan Favorite" (or ""). category is a short label like Wine, Beer, Bourbon, Spirits or Cigars. photo is a file name in src/assets/photos/ (items without a photo show as text-only cards).

items.name: Blanton's Original Single Barrel
items.note: The original single barrel bourbon. Soft caramel, orange and vanilla. Grab it when you see it.

items.name: Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label
items.note: The celebration bottle. Toasty, lively and always worth it.

items.name: Bell's Two Hearted Ale
items.note: Michigan's iconic IPA from Kalamazoo. Bright, piney and always in the cooler.

items.name: Padrón Cigars
items.note: Rich, smooth Nicaraguan cigars that pair perfectly with a pour of bourbon.
